covers: JSE session to about 14:18 SAST on 20 Nov 2026, with Thursday's US close for reference
headline: JSE slips back: All Share 104,757 (-1.4%), Top 40 96,935 (-1.5%) as miners extend losses; rand near R17.47/$
summary: The JSE All Share was at 104,757.25 and the Top 40 at 96,935.05 at about 14:30 SAST on 20 Nov 2026, 1.4% and 1.5% below Thursday's closes of 106,216.49 and 98,385.12, giving back part of the late-morning recovery (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance). Wall Street's last close was the S&P 500 at 7,175.83 and the Nasdaq at 23,879.20 on 19 Nov; US trading resumes at 16:30 SAST. Gold was at $3,576.40, 1.4% above Thursday's close but 8.0% lower on the week, and the rand was at R17.47 per dollar, 4.3% weaker than on 13 Nov.

items.title: All Share 104,757.25 (-1.4%), Top 40 96,935.05 (-1.5%) as losses widen again
items.summary: At 11:00 SAST the indices were down 0.8% and 0.9%; by about 14:30 SAST they had slipped back, though they remain above the early lows of 104,265.03 and 96,398.30. The All Share is 6.8% below its 13 Nov level of 112,387.90 and the Top 40 7.2% below 104,486.60 (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance, 20 Nov 2026 ~14:30 SAST).

items.title: Miners lose more ground: Anglo American -3.9%, Impala -3.9%, Sibanye-Stillwater -3.1%, Harmony -2.9%, AngloGold -2.6%
items.summary: Gold Fields was 2.1% lower at R569.86, BHP 2.1% lower at R598.37 and Glencore 2.6% lower at R104.17, all weaker than at 11:00 SAST (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 20 Nov 2026 ~14:18 SAST).

items.title: Shoprite +1.8%, BAT +1.4%, Mr Price +1.3%; Naspers -3.5%, Prosus -3.6%
items.summary: Shoprite was at R341.78, BAT at R1,005.42 and Mr Price at R180.23, while Naspers (R635.16) and Prosus (R591.00) fell further than this morning. Banks were little changed: Standard Bank -0.7% (R282.40), FirstRand -0.6% (R87.82), Absa -0.6% (R207.69) (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 20 Nov 2026 ~14:18 SAST).

items.title: Last close: S&P 500 7,175.83, Nasdaq 23,879.20 (19 Nov)
items.summary: Wall Street opens at 16:30 SAST. Thursday's close left the S&P 500 5.1% lower on the week and the Nasdaq 5.0% lower; the US 10-year yield closed at 5.05% (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance, 19 Nov 2026).

items.title: Rand at R17.47/$, 4.3% weaker on the week
items.summary: USD/ZAR at 17.4737 on 20 Nov 2026 (about 14:30 SAST) vs 16.7584 on 13 Nov; the euro is at R19.17 and the pound at R22.89 (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance).

items.title: Gold $3,576.40; platinum $1,305.70; Brent $89.28; copper $12,196/t
items.summary: Gold futures are 1.4% above Thursday's close of $3,526.30 but 8.0% below the 13 Nov level of $3,886.30; platinum is 12.3% lower on the week, Brent 6.8% lower and copper 9.0% lower (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance, 20 Nov 2026 ~14:30 SAST).

items.title: MTN flat at R224.50, Telkom flat at R66.96
items.summary: Both are holding up better than the Top 40 (-1.5%); MTN has given back its morning gain (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 20 Nov 2026 ~14:18 SAST). No company news; ratings unchanged.

items.title: US names unchanged since Thursday's close: Nvidia $145.98, Meta $596.22, Intuit $310.02, Deckers $78.95
items.summary: No new US trading until 16:30 SAST; Thursday's moves were Nvidia -3.3%, Meta -3.3%, Intuit -1.0% and Deckers -5.6% (LRC Stock Scanner, 19 Nov 2026 close). Ratings unchanged.
